newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end down, seen rising on OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end down, seen rising on OMO.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market is expected to rise on Wednesday when the central bank is likely to conduct an open market operation (OMO), dealers said.
Overnight funds were initially offered at three percent to four percent but as no deals were cut at this level desperate lenders lowered their offers to 1.5 percent, one said.
He said rates were likely to rise on Wednesday as the State (central) Bank of Pakistan was expected to pick up heavy amounts in an open market operation.
